20. OWASP Top 10 Awareness

SIMPLE ENGLISH
OWASP Top 10 highlights major web application risk categories; it is an awareness resource, not
a complete checklist.

A team checks permissions, dependencies, secure defaults and failure handling before release.

Expected result: Review covers several risks, not every possible vulnerability.
Is passing OWASP Top 10 enough? No; use threat modeling, testing and detailed requirements too.
